title: Blueface Claims Chrisean Jr. as His Son Once Again
excerpt: Blue says he's the daddy.
summary: Blueface is once again publicly claiming paternity of Chrisean Rock's son, following months of back-and-forth between the two over the child's paternity. The claim reignites a saga that has played out largely on livestreams and social media between the on-again, off-again couple.

title: Cardi B Explains 'Can't Trap Me' Lyric From New Viral Song Teaser
excerpt: Belcalis explains it all.
summary: Cardi B is breaking down a viral lyric from a new song teaser that had fans buzzing online. In her explanation, Bardi walked through the meaning behind the line and the moment that inspired it.

title: Ice Spice Launches Her First Fragrance In Ha Mood
excerpt: The bottle comes in three sizes.
summary: Ice Spice is expanding into beauty with the launch of her debut fragrance, In Ha Mood. The scent arrives in three bottle sizes as the Bronx rapper continues building out her brand beyond music.

title: Mellow Rackz Reveals Two Giant YoungBoy Never Broke Again Tattoos
excerpt: Mellow showed off the ink while playing YB's song "No. 9."
summary: Mellow Rackz showed off two large new tattoos dedicated to YoungBoy Never Broke Again, unveiling the ink while playing YB's track "No. 9." The gesture underscores Mellow's loyalty within the NBA YoungBoy camp.

title: Judge Rules Rap Lyrics May Be Used in Yella Beezy's Trial
excerpt: The judge keeps some rap lyrics and rules against others.
summary: A judge has ruled that some of Yella Beezy's rap lyrics can be introduced as evidence in his ongoing trial, while ruling against the use of others. The decision adds to the broader legal debate over using rap lyrics as evidence in criminal cases.

title: Young Thug Buys Luxurious $5 Million Estate in Florida
excerpt: Thug mansion.
summary: Young Thug has purchased a $5 million estate in Florida, adding a lavish new property to his real estate portfolio. The move comes as the Atlanta rapper continues to settle into life post-release.

title: Skrilla and Keyshia Cole Spark Dating Rumors With Cozy New Photos
excerpt: Are Skrilla and Keyshia boo'd up?
summary: New photos of Skrilla and Keyshia Cole together are fueling speculation that the two are dating. Fans quickly picked up on the chemistry between the pair after the images surfaced online.

title: Drakeo The Ruler's Security Guard Says YG Had Knife During Brawl
excerpt: The plot thickens.
summary: A security guard connected to the late Drakeo The Ruler claims YG was carrying a knife during the brawl that preceded Drakeo's death. The claim adds a new detail to the ongoing investigation into the incident.

title: 2026 XXL Freshman Cypher With Chris Patrick, Slayr & More
excerpt: These rappers are prepared to show off their lyrical skills in the Freshman cypher.
summary: This year's XXL Freshman class steps up for the magazine's signature cypher, trading bars alongside names like Chris Patrick and Slayr. The cypher is one of the most anticipated moments of the annual Freshman rollout.

title: Chris Brown Pleads Guilty in Case of Producer Hit With Bottle
excerpt: Brown will be sentenced later this year.
summary: Chris Brown has pleaded guilty in a case stemming from an incident in which a producer was struck with a bottle. He's expected to be sentenced later this year, with the plea closing out a legal chapter that had been pending for months.

title: DJ Akademiks Surprisingly Praises JAY-Z's Concert... With A Catch
excerpt: DJ Akademiks' issue with JAY-Z and his 2026 run is the same problem he had with his Roots Picnic festival set.
summary: DJ Akademiks had mostly positive things to say about JAY-Z's recent Yankee Stadium concert, calling it a great show, but he wasn't as kind about the freestyle Hov delivered during it. Akademiks argued the freestyle segment has grown weaker each time Jay has used it.

title: Joe Budden Tears Into Future's "The Real Me": "I Almost Deleted This Bulls**t"
excerpt: The Joe Budden Podcast's other hosts were more charitable to Future's The Real Me, but sadly for Pluto, not by much.
summary: Joe Budden didn't hold back on his podcast while reviewing Future's new album The Real Me, admitting he almost deleted it from his phone after the first few tracks. His co-hosts pushed back, arguing the back half of the project has more to offer than Budden gave it credit for.

title: DJ Akademiks Releases Full Drake & JAY-Z Debate With Charlamagne Tha God
excerpt: DJ Akademiks and Charlamagne Tha God have been feuding over alleged Roc Nation ties, JAY-Z and Drake biases, botting claims, and more.
summary: DJ Akademiks and Charlamagne Tha God sat down for a nearly three-hour conversation covering their long-running disagreements over JAY-Z, Drake, and media bias in hip-hop coverage. The two didn't reach common ground, but the sit-down marked a rare direct exchange between two prominent hip-hop commentators.

title: Future's Artist Doe Boy Challenges NBA YoungBoy To Fight After Diss
excerpt: NBA YoungBoy recently dropped a diss track against Future and continued to taunt the Freebandz crew by dissing Doe Boy on his Instagram post.
summary: Freebandz artist Doe Boy publicly challenged NBA YoungBoy to a fight after YB took shots at him online amid his ongoing feud with Future. The exchange is the latest flashpoint in the beef between YoungBoy and Future's camp.

title: Drake Puts $1 Million On Conor McGregor Winning His UFC Comeback
excerpt: Drake has had relatively mixed betting luck as of late when it comes to sports, but he's confident in Conor McGregor's greatness.
summary: Drake placed a $1 million bet on Conor McGregor's UFC comeback fight against Max Holloway at UFC 329, sharing the wager on Instagram ahead of the bout. The bet follows a recent multimillion-dollar win Drake landed through Stake.

title: Future Releases 10th Solo Studio Album 'The Real Me'
excerpt: Multi-GRAMMY Award-winning artist Future has released his highly anticipated 10th solo studio album, The Real Me.
summary: Future has released his 10th solo studio album, The Real Me, following the lead single "Radio." The project marks another entry in the Atlanta rapper's prolific run of solo releases.

title: Tristan Thompson Tells Klay Thompson to Stay Quiet After Megan Thee Stallion Split
excerpt: If anyone knows a thing or two about a high-profile romance and breakup, it's Tristan Thompson.
summary: Tristan Thompson offered Klay Thompson some relationship advice on Club Shay Shay, encouraging him to stay quiet following his split from Megan Thee Stallion. Thompson drew on his own experience navigating high-profile breakups in the public eye.

title: 50 Cent Celebrates Three Emmy Nominations for 'Sean Combs: The Reckoning'
excerpt: 50 Cent is taking a victory lap at his enemy's expense. His docuseries has earned three nominations at the 2026 Emmy Awards.
summary: 50 Cent's docuseries Sean Combs: The Reckoning has picked up three Emmy nominations, giving the mogul a moment to celebrate amid his long-running rivalry with Diddy. The Netflix documentary continues to draw attention for its look into Combs' downfall.

title: Today In Hip Hop History: Intelligent Hoodlum Dropped His Self Titled Debut Album 36 Years Ago
excerpt: Long before he became known simply as Tragedy Khadafi, Queensbridge lyricist Percy Chapman made one of the most powerful introductions of the Golden Era.
summary: Before he became known as Tragedy Khadafi, Queensbridge lyricist Percy Chapman introduced himself to hip-hop with his self-titled debut, Intelligent Hoodlum. The album remains one of the notable releases to come out of the Juice Crew era.

title: Stacey Dash's Viral Post Shuts Down Racist Facebook Claim Effortlessly
excerpt: A racist Facebook post is getting plenty of attention online, but not for the reason its creators probably expected.
summary: A racist Facebook post aimed at stirring division instead went viral for the wrong reasons after Stacey Dash publicly responded to it. Her reply drew widespread attention online, turning the original post into a talking point about the pushback it received.
